message.content:
Paris is renowned worldwide for its iconic landmarks and cultural treasures. While there isn’t one single “most famous” spot—different people might point to different symbols depending on their interests—the following locations consistently rank at the top when visitors think of what makes Paris unforgettable:

| # | Place | Why It’s Famous |
|---|-------|----------------|
| **1** | *Eiffel Tower* (Tour Eiffel) | A global symbol of romance and engineering brilliance, offering panoramic views from three observation decks. |
| **2** | *Louvre Museum* (Musée du Louvre) | Home to thousands of masterpieces—including Leonardo da Vinci’s *Mona Lisa*—and the world’s largest art museum. |
| **3** | *Notre‑Dame Cathedral* (Cathédrale Notre-Dame de Paris) | An architectural marvel of Gothic design, famed before the fire for its stained glass and historic significance. |
| **4** | *Champs‑Élysées & Arc de Triomphe* | One of the world’s most celebrated avenues leading up to the triumphal arch honoring French military victories. |
| **5** | *Montmartre & Sacré‑Coeur Basilica* | Known as the bohemian heart of Paris, this hilltop neighborhood offers artistic history and sweeping city vistas. |

If you’re planning a visit, consider combining several of these sites into a day itinerary—or simply let your curiosity guide you through the streets of Paris!
